messages:
maria: Opening a follow-up thread for the postmortem on the token validation 401 spikes yesterday during peak ingest. We saw short windows (~3-7m) where token service returned 401s for otherwise-valid tokens, and audit logs were sparse. Need owners, remediation timeline, and a detection rule so this doesn't recur.

sam: I can take infra + client retry/backoff changes. Will open JIRA INF-24321 and draft the patch for client SDKs to add jittered exponential backoff (limit 3 retries). ETA EOW.

liam: I'll own the audit logging gaps. Initial glance shows the token-validate service dropped logs when memcat evictions happened. I'll add guaranteed write + local buffer fallback. Also will add a query to detect missing consecutive audit IDs.

alex: I'll handle the KV cache eviction tuning and an autoscaling policy for token-validate. Proposing: increase cache TTL to 5m for tokens with >1 request/min, and add scale-up at 70% cache miss rate. Will test on staging.

carla: From security side, we need a secrets rotation check for the token-signing key. I'll run manual check now and open SEC-6123 if rotation is overdue. If rotation is required we should coordinate downtime window with apps.

maria: Action items so far:
- sam: client retry + SDK patch, JIRA INF-24321, due 2026-03-27
- liam: durable audit write + detection query, JIRA SRE-9988, due 2026-04-02
- alex: cache TTL + autoscale tuning, PR to infra repo, due 2026-04-01
- carla: secrets rotation audit, SEC ticket if needed, due 2026-03-26
Please add any dependencies and estimate hours.

sam: dependency: SDK rollout cadence (we need 48h canary in prod). Estimate 4 dev hrs + 2 QA hrs.

liam: paste of detection query I'm going to add to our alerts (Prometheus/QL style):
```
count_over_time(token_audit_entries_total{env="prod"}[1h]) < 100 and increase(token_audit_entries_total{env="prod"}[15m]) == 0
```
This flags long windows with low audit writes for the token service. I'll convert to our alerting rule and tune thresholds after a day.

alex: infra note: to reproduce the memcat eviction pattern I used this load command on staging: `wrk -t8 -c200 --timeout 5s http://staging-token-validate.local/validate` — that recreated the miss spikes. Share logs if helpful.

carla: I checked signing key rotation: last rotation timestamp is 2025-08-03, so not immediately expired but documented for planned rotation next quarter. I'll still run the key integrity checks and add a cryptographic audit event to the flow.

maria: Good. We should also add a recurring postmortem follow-up in the incident playbook to check for patterns (monthly) and track recurring causes. Suggest weekly sync for the next 3 weeks to close items faster. Who's ok with weekly 30m?

sam: +1 for weekly 30m. Put me on calendar.

liam: +1, prefer mornings.

alex: OK. I'll set up a kanban column for this incident in the infra board and tag the PRs.

carla: I'll add the SEC risk assessment entry and link SEC-6123 if created.

incident-bot: scheduled a recurring follow-up: "token-validation-remediation-check" every Tuesday 09:30 UTC for 3 weeks. Calendar invite sent to mari, sam, liam, alex, carla.

maria: Thanks all. Final ask: please add short status updates in this thread as you make progress (PR links, JIRA IDs, and any regression tests). We'll close this thread once all items have owners, PRs merged, and the alert has run for 48h without firing. :thumbsup:
